interpretation: Across all 10 model-target pairs, Relative-minus-Absolute and Hybrid-minus-Absolute Between-minus-Within profile contrasts remain negative over the full matched-alpha grid. This supports that the core component direction and Hybrid under-recovery are not single-alpha artifacts. Hybrid-minus-Relative is less stable for 2/10 pairs, which is retained as a boundary condition rather than used for post-hoc alpha selection.
